projects.name: AZOR: Search, Location and Rescue of People on Land, and Fire Fighting and Prevention
projects.summary: The project addresses the development of an object detection system with RGB and thermal camera to be run on an FPGA on board a UAV for two use cases: (i) search, location and rescue of people on land; (ii) fire prevention and firefighting.
